verdict.rationale: Statsig docs state that after initialization both client and server SDKs evaluate gates and experiments without a network request, typically in under 1ms. The docs also say evaluation is deterministic across client and server. Together these cover the core of local, no-network flag checks. missing for 10: explicit documentation that server SDKs download and cache the full ruleset and how it syncs, latency quantified at microsecond rather than sub-millisecond level, independent or hands-on corroboration.
